title: Crab with lemon new potatoes
summary: Crab with lemon new potatoes is a british dinner built around white crab meat and new potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat white crab meat dry and season it. Prep new potatoes and lemon juice for Crab with lemon new potatoes so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook white crab meat on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook new potatoes and lemon juice in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Crab with lemon new potatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice white crab meat and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
